mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% for two consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.0% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and core inflation signal successful monetary policy easing that reduces real interest rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decline, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by strong housing market activity, measured by HOUST above 1600 thousand units, consumer spending remains robust, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (base 2017=100) for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction that signals weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth, measured by GDPC1 above 2.5% annualized rate, reflects robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment growth rate below 0.5% indicates labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales, measured by RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars, indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 700,000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.
